title: Alternatives To Fighting
implemented: Use 3 Force to cancel a system or sector battle just initiated; the same option does not cancel a Besieged site battle.
Cancel Besieged while deploying or on table. Canceling the Effect does not cancel an already underway battle.

Release all eligible own trapped characters to any docking bay, including the occupied bay holding the captured ship. Personal attachments accompany the characters, and regular movement use remains unchanged.
Captured ship with its final trapped character released follows mandatory theft rules. Original targets cannot be revived by leaving and returning during responses.
A hit character leaving its Besieged battle by release is immediately lost, with a saved loss-prevention response for the character and personal equipment.
referenceStatus: Executed remote release and battle cancellation match; same-bay diagnostic retained a failing weapon-attachment assertion. See raw results and provenance; no blanket GEMP-equivalence claim.
limitations: Pinned GEMP does not implement Besieged2_117, so Besieged-specific modes are official-card-text plus native-integration coverage, not executed GEMP equivalence.

relatedPriorBatch.scope: 15 Alternatives cases plus Besieged and captured-ship regressions before the additional hit-release correction
